顾承安掏出自己的保密手机，拨通了陆鸣的号码。

“我在十六铺码头东路，江景商务酒店204房间，抓了一个。”

电话那头陆鸣明显一愣：“你一个人？”

顾承安没有解释。

“人已经铐了，昏过去了，你带队过来一趟。”

“好的，我马上过去！”

陆鸣没再多问。

顾承安把手机收回兜里，拖了把椅子坐到许晴旁边，她侧躺在地上，双手反铐在身后，下颌角的位置已经开始泛红。

呼吸均匀，短时间是醒不了了。

刚坐下，走廊里便传来一阵急促的脚步声。

前台阿姨来了。

她扶着门框探进半个身子，看见屋里的场景——地上躺着个昏迷的女人，手上还戴着手铐，门锁被踹得稀烂，房门大敞。

阿姨的脸色当场就变了。

“你干什么的！你这是干什么！踹我的门！我要报警！”

她嗓门相当大，中气十足，看得出来是在这一带摸爬滚打多年的老油条，什么场面都见过，一点不怵。

顾承安不慌不忙地从口袋里掏出证件，翻开，亮到她面前。

阿姨眯着眼睛凑近看了看，随后嘀咕了一句本地话。

“伐好拿鹅个门猜坏脱个呀！”

“我这边已经通知同事过来了。”顾承安收回证件，“门的损失，到时候会有人对接你，该赔的一分不少。”

阿姨的目光在证件、地上的女人、和顾承安之间来回转了转。

她到底是个老江湖，迅速完成了利弊分析，态度一百八十度转弯：“哦哦，那行那行，你忙你忙……”

说完转身就往楼下撤，一点不带犹豫的！

走廊里这时还探出来几颗脑袋，隔壁203和对面201的住客都被动静惊动了，伸着脖子往这边张望。

顾承安站起身，走到门口，面无表情扫了一眼。

“警方办案，无关人员回避。”

语气不重，但那股子压迫感是实实在在的。几个住客对视一眼，识趣地缩回去，房门关得比谁都快。

走廊安静下来。

顾承安回到椅子上坐下，靠着椅背。

Gu Chengan took out his confidential mobile phone and dialed Lu Ming's number.

"I caught one in Room 204 of Jiangjing Business Hotel on Shiliupu Pier East Road."

Lu Ming on the other end of the phone was obviously stunned: "Are you alone?"

Gu Chengan didn't explain.

"The person has been handcuffed and passed out. Please lead a team over here."

"Okay, I'll be there right away!"

Lu Ming didn't ask any more questions.

Gu Chengan put his phone back in his pocket, pulled a chair and sat next to Xu Qing. She was lying on her side on the ground, her hands cuffed behind her back, and the corner of her jaw had begun to turn red.

Breathe evenly, I won't wake up soon.

As soon as he sat down, there was a rush of footsteps in the corridor.

The aunt at the front desk is here.

Holding on to the door frame, she leaned halfway in and saw the scene inside the room - an unconscious woman was lying on the ground, with handcuffs still on her hands, the door lock was kicked to pieces, and the door was wide open.

Auntie's expression changed on the spot.

"What are you doing! What are you doing! Kick my door! I want to call the police!"

Her voice was quite loud and full of energy. It was obvious that she was an experienced veteran who had been working in this area for many years. She had seen all kinds of scenes and was not afraid at all.

Gu Chengan calmly took out his ID from his pocket, opened it, and showed it to her.

The aunt squinted her eyes and looked closer, then muttered something in local dialect.

"It's better to guess the wrong one and take it off!"

"I have already notified my colleagues to come over." Gu Chengan took back his ID, "Someone will take care of you for the damage to the door. You should pay a lot of compensation."

The aunt's eyes flickered back and forth between the certificate, the woman on the ground, and Gu Chengan.

After all, she is a veteran. She quickly completed the pros and cons analysis and turned her attitude 180 degrees: "Oh, oh, that line of work, that line of work, you are busy, you are busy..."

After saying that, he turned around and headed downstairs without any hesitation!

A few heads poked out of the corridor at this time. The residents in 203 next door and 201 opposite were all startled by the silence and stretched their necks to look here.

Gu Chengan stood up, walked to the door, and glanced expressionlessly.

"The police are handling the case and irrelevant personnel are avoiding it."

The tone was not serious, but the feeling of oppression was real.Several residents looked at each other, shrank back knowingly, and closed the door faster than anyone else.

The corridor fell silent.

Gu Chengan returned to the chair and sat down, leaning on the back of the chair.
